components.content:
# Roles & Perks

Our server uses a tiered role system. As you participate, you unlock new perks!

content.content:
**How to rank up:**
- Chat in text channels
- Join voice channels
- Participate in events

components.content: -# Select a category below for details on each tier.

# Starter Roles

🟢 **Newcomer** — Granted on join
🔵 **Regular** — After 1 week of activity

# Veteran Roles

🟣 **Veteran** — 1 month of activity
🟡 **Legend** — 6 months of activity
